tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅// bsang rngan gyi cho ga nyes pa rnams sel dgos 'dod kun 'grub ces bya ba bzhugs so//

bla ma dang ni lhag pa'i lhar// gus btud bsang rngan cho ga ni// nyes pa rnams sel dgos 'dod kun// 'grub byed 'dir bri nyams su longs// sgrub pa po'i gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi nyes pa thams cad sel zhing dgos pa'i don kun bsgrub pa'i phyir du zla ba gang yang rung ba'i tshes gsum/ brgyad// bco lnga/ gnam gang la sogs pa'i dus dge ba'i snga dro khang steng la sogs pa gtsang zhing dben pa'i gnas su/ gzhi ma dkar po'i steng du 'bru sna tshogs kyi gcal bkram pa'i steng du/gtor snod gas chag med pa'i nang du/ 'bru sna tshogs kyi zan la ri rab bang rim bzhi pa'i steng du/ ma mo'i gtor ma pad+mas bskor ba/ de'i mdun du mchog gsum la zlum gtor/ g.yas su yi dam la dpal gtor/ rgyab tu mkha' 'gro la dpal gtor rgyab tu dbal med pa/ g.yon du chos skyong la dpal gtor/ ri rab kyi mdun du g.yag lug ra gsum/ mtha' bskor du sde brgyad bshos bu dang*/ 'brang rgyas/ bsang phyi/ ting lo/ ril bu/ ong kyu/ chang bu la sogs pa ci mang gis bskor ba bshams/ rgyas par 'dod na brngan gyi cho ga gzhan nas 'byung ba ltar par btab pa'am| 'og nas 'byung ba lta bu'i gtor ma rnams so sor bcos pas bskor/ dkar dmar gyi rgyan dang dar zab kyi gur phub/ de dag gi mdun du ci 'byor ba'i mchod pa dang spyan gzigs mda' dar/ me long stag gzig gi ras mo gser g.yu la sogs pas brgyan pa dang*/ dkar gsum/ mngar gsum/ ja chang khrag 'o ma la sogs pa'i phud dang*/ phye mar/ gser skyems/ bza' bca' btung ba la sogs pa bshams/ 'og nas bsang gi skabs su 'byung ba lta bu'i shing rnams gang 'dzom gyi bsang la sman sna dar sna rin po che sna tshogs btab pa sogs nyer 'kho thams cad tshogs par bshams/ sgrub pa po stan bde bar shar du phyogs pas/ na mo/ bla ma bde gshegs 'dus pa'i sku// dkon mchog gsum gyi rang bzhin la// bdag dang 'gro drug sems can rnams// byang chub bar du skyabs su mchi// zhes skyabs 'gro lan gsum/

sems bskyed ni/ sems bskyed 'gro ba kun don du// bla ma sangs rgyas bsgrubs nas ni// gang la gang 'dul phrin las kyis// 'gro drug sgrol bar sems bskyed do// lan gsum/ yan lag bdun pa ni/ hūm̐ */ bla ma yi dam lha tshogs gshegs// nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs// lus ngag yid gsum gus phyag 'tshal// phyi nang gsang gsum mchod pa 'bul// nyams chag sdig sgrib mthol zhing bshags// gsang sngags sgrub la rjes yi rang*// smin grol chos 'khor bskor du gsol// mya ngan mi 'da' gzhan don bzhugs// snying po sems can don phyir bsngo// yang dag rdo rje'i don rtogs shog /lan gsum/ hūm̐ */ o rgyan yul gyi nub byang mtshams// pad+ma ge sar sdong po la// ya mtshan mchog gi dngos grub brnyes// pad+ma 'byung gnas zhes su grags// 'khor du mkha' 'gro mang pos bskor// khyed kyi rjes su bdag bsgrub phyir// byin gyis brlab phyir gshegs su gsol// zhes tshig bdun ma'i gsol ba btab cing*/ hūm̐ */ bstan pa 'di la ngo mtshar rmad byung ba// 'jig rten dbang gyur pad+ma rgyal po ni// rigs ni za hor rgyal po'i sras su 'khrungs// o rgyan yul du sgro 'dogs ma lus bcad// bsil ba'i tshal du dngos grub rnam gnyis brnyes// 'jig rten khams su gdug pa can rnams btul// kha ba can du bstan pa rgyas par mdzad// lho nub mtshams su srin po'i kha gnon mdzad// mya ngan mi 'da' 'gro ba'i gnyen gcig pu// sku gsum dbyer med che mchog he ru kaḥ /mnyam med bla ma mchog de dus 'dir dran// gsang sngags rgyal pos gnas 'dir byin phob la// rkyen ngan bar chad phyogs rnams zhi ba dang*| |mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// oṃ sku yi byin gyis brlab tu gsol// lus kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol// lha dbang lus la bskur du gsol// lus skye 'chi med pa'i dngos grub stsol/

/āḥgasung gi byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ /ngag gi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol/ /sngags dbang ngag la bskur du gsol// ngag snying po lung gi dngos grub stsol// hūm̐ thugs kyi byin gyis brlab tu gsol// sems kyi sgrib pa sbyang du gsol// chos dbang sems la bskur du gsol// sems skye med rtogs par byin gyis rlobs// dbang bzhi bskur bar mdzad du gsol// rgyud bzhi smin par mdzad du gsol// sku bzhi 'grub par mdzad du gsol// tshig dbang don mchog rtogs pa dang*// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsol// rang yi dam du gsal ba'i mchod gtor dang bsang rnams/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kun+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3 haṃ/ stong pa'i ngang las bh+rūṃ las rin po che'i snod yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i gtor ma rnams gzugs mdzes pa/ sgra snyan pa/ dri zhim pa/ ro bda' ba/ reg bya 'jam pa/ bza' bas mi zad pa/ btung bas mi zad pa/ rgol bas mi sdigs pa/ ri rgyal bas dpangs mtho ba/ rgya mtsho bas gting zab pa/ zhing rdul bas grangs mang ba/ nyi zla bas 'od gsal ba/ nam mkha'i mtha' dang mnyam pa'i 'dod yon mgron bzhi dgyes par skong ba/ nyams pa gso ba/ nad pa gso ba'i sman pa/ 'chi ba slu ba'i bdud rtsi/ dgos 'dod thams cad sgrub pa'i dngos po dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ bsang gi dud sprin ngo bo lha rdzas dri bzang gi mchod pa/ rtsi shing sna tshogs kyi dud pa/ zhal zas phye mar gyi 'o skom/ sman 'bru 'dod yon gyi dri bsung*/ gsur gyi dud sprin chen po du ba ye shes kyi bdud rtsi/ sa 'og sa bla sa steng khyab pa la/ rnam pa lha mo sku mdog sngon mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis ma/ g.yas bdud rtsi'i bum pa 'dzin pa mgron rigs thams cad la khrus byas pas/ sdig sgrib nad gdon thams cad ni phyag

/ro bag mi gtsang ba thams cad bdud rtsis bkrus nas dag par byas/ g.yon sman gyis bkang ba'i gzhong pa 'dzin pa'i nang nas sman dpag tu med pa thu lu lu byung bas/ klu gnyan sa bdag thams cad rmugs pa sangs nas sangs rgyas kyi bka' rjes su dran nas bdag cag la ci 'dod pa'i gdong grogs byed par gyur par bsam/ mchod gtor dang bsang rnams sngags drug phyag rgya drug gis byin gyis brlab pa ni/ sbyong ba chos nyid rnam par dag pa'i sngags rgya/ thal mo khong stong snying gar bcas la/ oṃ swa bhā wa shud+dhaḥsarba dharmāḥswa bhā wa shud+dho3haṃ/ spel ba nam mkha' mdzod kyi sngags rgya/ rdo rje nang bsdams cung zad glod pa khong stong byas te/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta bh+yo bi shwa mu khe bh+yaḥ sarba thā khaṃ uṅga te s+pha ra ṇa i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ swā hā/ bdud rtsi 'khyil ba'i sngags rgya/ rdor thal kha gyen du phyogs pas/ oṃ badz+ra a mṛ ta kuṇ+ḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ phaṭa/ spyod par dbang ba shugs ldan 'od kyi sngags rgya/ g.yon sdigs mdzub snying khar sbreng la/ g.yas sdigs mdzub rdzas rnams la g.yas su bskor zhing*/ na maḥsarba ta thā ga ta a wa lo ki te oṃ saṃ bha ra saṃ bha ra hūm̐/ ye shes skar mda'i sngags rgya/ g.yas sdigs mdzub snying gar sbreng la/ g.yon thal mo bkan nas rdzas 'degs pa'i tshul gyis/ oṃ dz+nyā na a wa lo ki te na mas+sa man+ta s+pha ra ṇa rasmi sam+bha wa sa ma ya ma hā ma ni du ru du ru hṛ da ya dz+wa la ni hūm̐/ dbang sgyur 'khor lo'i sngags rgya| lag gnyis kyi mthe bong dang mthe'u chung rnams sor sor sgreng*/ sor mo gzhan rnams kyi tshigs dang po bsnol te leb mor byas la kha sbub smin mtshams su/ na maḥs man+ta bud+dha nāṃ gra he shwa ri pra bhañdza dza ti ma hā sa ma ya swāhā/ zhes pas sngags rnams lan gsum gsum gyi byin gyis brlabs/ mgron bskyed pa ni/ mdun du pad dkar zla ba'i gdan stong gsum dang mnyam pa'i steng du hrīḥlas spyan ras gzigs ā ro li ka rgyan cha lugs kha sar+pa ṇi lta bu sku che ba rnam snang gangs chen mtsho dang mnyam pa/

zhing khams thams cad la skus khyab cing sku la zhing khams thams cad snang ba/ ba spu'i bu ga thams cad kyang sangs rgyas kyi zhing khams bsam gyis mi khyab pas gang ba/ de'i gtsug tor nas mgrin pa yan la dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron/ thugs ka nas lte ba'i bar mgon po yon tan gyi mgron/ sku smad kyi cha la rigs drug snying rje'i mgron/ pad gdan gyi cha la lan chags bu lon gyi mgron rnams kyis bskor bar gyur par bsam/ spyan drangs pa ni/ hūm̐ */ ma lus sems can kun gyi mgon gyur cing*| |bdud sde dpung bcas mi bzad 'joms mdzad lha// dngos rnams ma lus ji bzhin mkhyen gyur pa'i// bcom ldan 'khor bcas gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// rtsa brgyud bla ma sangs rgyas chos tshogs dang*// byang sems rang rgyal nyan thos dgra bcom tshogs// yi dam rgyal ba zhi khro 'khor dang bcas// dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron kun gshegs su gsol// mkha' 'gro dam can chos skyong bstan srung tshogs// 'go ba'i lha lnga dpal mgon bdun cu lnga// nor lha lha srin sde brgyad 'khor dang bcas// mgon po yon tan mgron kun gshegs su gsol| |lha dang lha min mi dang dud 'gro dang*// yi dwags dmyal ba'i 'jigs rten gyis bsdus pa'i// khams gsum srid gsum gnas na gang 'khod pa// rigs drug snying rje'i mgron rnams gshegs su gsol// bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad kyi// tshe rabs sngon nas da lta'i mur thug bar// bu lon sha 'khon stong 'dril gang chags pa'i// tshe rabs lan chags mgron kun gshegs su gsol// badz+ra sa mā dzaḥ zhes spyan drangs/ hūm̐ */ phyogs bcu nam mkha' yangs pa'i dkyil 'khor nas// rnam bzhi'i mgron rnams bu yug ltar byon te// bskyed pa'i mgron rigs rnams la gnyis med par// thim zhing bde ba'i stan la bzhugs su gsol// sa ma ya tiṣ+ṭha lhan/ zhes bzhugs su gsol/

hūm̐ */ 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das zhes// ma rtogs 'khrul ngor cir yang snang*// mnyam nyid don du ye nas gcig /rol pa chen por phyag bgyi'o// a ti pū hoḥ pra ti dza hoḥ zhes phyag 'tshal| hūm̐/ rnam bzhi mgron gyi tshogs bcas la// phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod sprin tshogs// rang rang rigs mthun dgyes skong rdzas// nam mkha' bkang ste bdag gis dbul// pū dza pra tīts+tsha hoḥ zhes mchod/ hūm̐ */ bstod par 'os pa rnam bzhi'i mgron// zhing rdul grangs snyed bsam 'das la// bdag lus de dang mnyam sprul pas// bstod dbyangs snyan sprin dga' bas bstod// ces bstod/ bsang la phye mar dar zab rin po che sman spos chang la sogs pa sgron la/ ༈ /e ma hoḥde dgongs su gsol// gling bzhi'i mchog gyur lho rgyal 'dzam bu gling*// 'dzam gling byang shar ri rgyal rta na 'dzin// de la 'dod yon kun ldan shing gsum skyes// rtsa bar mkhan pa gser gyi me tog can// sked par g.yu shug 'bras ldan mya ngan med// rtse mor bal lu dung gi me tog can// yon tan ldan pa'i shing gsum de dag ni// ston dpyid dbyar dgun mi nyams margad mdog /'dab ma'i gos gyon me tog lang tsho spen// 'bras bu'i dga' ston mgron bzhi'i dgyes pa skong*// dri zhim ngad ldan srid gsum yid rab 'phrog /me rlung sbyar ba'i dud sprin nam mkha' khengs// sngags dang phyag rgya'i dgyes dgu'i longs spyod sprul// lha 'dre mi gsum 'khon 'dzin phrag dog dang*// mi gtsang 'bag btsog ro bag nyams 'khon grib// dme mdze yug shan gza' skar sbyor byed tshes// lo zla zhag dus skag ngan bar gcod rkyen// mo ltas rmi lam than ltas mtshan ma ngan// byad phur rbod gtong mi mthun gnod pa'i phyogs// rdo rje'i slob dpon dam bral nyes ltung dang*// srung ma'i dam g.yel chos skyong 'khu zhing ldog / mkha' 'gro'i chad pa sde brgyad ngan sbyor dang*// lha klu sa bdag 'khrugs dang phog thug dang*// yul mkhar khang khyim rtsig nyes sa rko dang*// brag gshig rdo slog shing bcad chu gnyan dkrugs// cho ga nor 'khrul bskyed rdzogs bzlas sgom 'phyug

/las sbyor skyengs dred 'dzol dang log rdugs 'byams// de sogs ngan dgu sel zhing bzang po'i phyogs| |gnas skabs mthar thug bsam don sgrub pa'i thabs// bsang gi cho ga zab mo bsgrubs pa'i mthus// 'od gsal me lces ma rig rmongs mun sel// me stag tsha zhing 'phro bas mi mthun phyogs// mi gtsang ljan ljin lhag med sreg byed cing*// dud pas rnam bzhi'i mgron gyi dgyes pa skong*// sngags 'chang 'khor bcas bsam don myur sgrub pa'i// bsang khrus sngags dang phyag rgyas byin brlabs pa// legs par spyad pas mi 'byung mi 'thob med// lhag bsam bden pas mi 'grub mi tshim med// rten 'brel zab mos mi tshang mi mthol med// rgyu rkyen tshogs pas thams cad 'grub par gsungs// zhes dang*/ e ma hoḥ de ring gnam la gza' dang skar ma bzang*// sa gzhi dpyad legs nyi 'od 'jam la dro// bar du bsil bu'i ngad med 'dod dgu tshang*// sangs rgyas rdzu 'phrul mthu chen dgra bcom tshogs// zag pa rnam zad sngags 'chang bden pa grub// bsang ngo mchod do kun bzang mchod pa'i sprin// bdud rtsi'i ro reg dri ldan shing gi mchog /tsan+dan dkar dmar a ka ru dang ni// du ru ka dang smyug lo shug pa dang*// bal bu dkar nag phur mong rgod dang g.yung*// ma nu ru rta g.yu mchong dung dang gser// rtsi mar 'bru bcud sman spos dar dang zab// phye mar 'o skom 'dod yon kun ldan pa'i// dud sprin khams gsum srid gsum yongs khyab pas/ dang po dkon mchog sri zhu'i mgron rnams ni/ dbang bskur rgyud bshad man ngag kun byin pa'i// bka' drin sum ldan rtsa ba'i bla ma bsangs// dam chos klog sbyin 'chad ston man ngag bstan// dbang bskur dkyil 'khor las mdzad slob dpon drug /bsang ngo mchod do thugs dang 'gal ba bshags// rgyal ba dgongs brgyud rig 'dzin brda brgyud dang*// gang zag snyan brgyud smon lam dbang brgyud dang*| |shog ser tshig brgyud mkha' 'gro gtad rgya'i brgyud// brgyud pa drug ldan rtsa brgyud bla ma bsangs// mdo sde 'dul ba mngon pa bka' yi tshogs// rnam dag dgongs 'grel bstan bcos la sogs pa'i// lung dang man ngag brgyud pa'i bla ma bsangs// so thar mkhan brgyud byang sems sdom brgyud dang*// rig 'dzin smin grol lam gyi brgyud pa bsangs// bla rdzogs thugs gsum phyag chen chos drug dang*// zhi byed lam 'bras sbyor drug rim pa lnga// dbu ma gcod yul mtshan nyid mos gus dang*// ni gu bsnyen sgrub rten 'brel ro snyoms dang*// dmar khrid lhan skyes lnga ldan la sogs pa// rim gnyis zab khrid brgyud pa thams cad bsangs// sgra tshad bzo gso nang don sdeb sbyor dang*// mngon brjod zlos gar tshig rgyan rtsis la sogs// rig gnas bcu phrag brgyud pa'i tshogs rnams bsangs// rgya bod rig 'dzin brgyad dang slob dpon brgyad// grub chen brgyad dang grub thob brgyad cu dang*| |bstan pa rgyas mdzad gnas brtan bcu drug dang*// 'dzam gling mdzes byed rgyan drug mchog gnyis dang*// paṇa chen grub thob lo tsā sgra bsgyur tshogs// dus gsum phyogs bcu kun tu gshegs bzhugs pa'i// rtsa brgyud bla ma dge ba'i bshes la sogs// 'dren mchog rnams la bsang gi mchod pa 'bul// dbang bskur byin rlobs mchog gi dngos grub stsol//

kyai bsangs so// 'das dang ma 'ongs da lta dus gsum du// phyogs bcu'i zhing du bzhugs pa'i rdzogs sangs rgyas// don gnyis mthar phyin zla med skyabs kyi mchog /ston pa sangs rgyas thams cad bsang gis mchod// gang gi chags bral lam dang 'gog pa'i bden// gnyis kyis bsdus pa theg gsum dam pa'i chos// mdo sngags bka' dang bstan bcos rig pa'i gnas| |lam mchog dam pa'i chos kyi tshogs rnams bsangs// blo ldan theg chen phyir mi ldog pa'i tshogs// dgra bcom rnam gnyis phyir 'ong mi 'ong dang*// nyan thos 'phags mchog tshogs kyi zhing gyur pa// theg gsum dge 'dun 'dus pa'i tshogs rnams bsangs// brtse ldan snying rje'i bdag nyid byang chub sems// nye ba'i sras chen brgyad dang rigs gsum mgon| |srid mthar phyin dang 'khor bar 'jug mdzad pa'i// byang chub sems dpa'i tshogs rnams thams cad bsangs// dgyes par rab skong dngos grub mchog stsol cig /kyai bsangs so| |'das dus rgyal ba klu yi rigs mchog dbyangs// ma 'ongs mgon po kun tu gzigs pa'i mtshan// da lta sangs rgyas mos pa rab dga' ba'i// snying po nor bu rin chen brtsegs rgyal po// sems dpa'i tshul bzung rje btsun 'jam dpal dbyangs// gdul dka' 'dul phyir khro bo'i skur bstan pa// bcom ldan phyag rgya zil gnon yab dang yum| |sras mchog sku gsung sprul pa 'khor bcas la// bsang dang zhi ba'i mchod pa dam pa 'bul// rtsa ba'i lha drug rgyan gyi lha brgyad dang*// khro bcu sprul pa rnam gsum gshed chen bzhi| |mon pa bzhi dang bdud po chen po bzhi// 'chi bdag bcu gnyis zhag gshed sum cu gnyis// sgo skyong rnam bzhi pho gshed mo gshed tshogs// bdun brgya nyi shu yab yum sprul par bcas| |rang 'khor dregs pa'i tshogs dang bcas rnams la// bsang dang zhi ba'i dgyes mchod dam pa 'bul// rig rgyal nā ga rak+ṣa 'khor bcas dang*// khro chu dug gdong shor sang nyi ma khros// 'char ka nag po ru mtshon dmar nag dang*// kha thun nag po bse nag par bu sogs// 'jam dpal nyid las thugs rje'i sgyu 'phrul gar// sna tshogs khro bo'i skur bstan thams cad la// bsang dang zhi ba'i mchod pa deng 'dir 'bul// sprul pa'i drang srong dri med 'od zer mchog

/dregs pa 'dul phyir zhe sdang rdo rjer sprul// 'khor tshogs drang srong 'bum phrag tshogs bcas la// rnam dag bsang dang zhi ba'i mchod pa 'bul// che mchog yon tan yang dag thugs dang ni// 'jam dpal sku dang pad+ma dbang chen gsung*// phur pa 'phrin las ma mo rbod gtong dang*// rig 'dzin slob dpon 'jig rten mchod bstod dang*// dmod pa drag sngags dpal gyi bka' srung sogs// sgrub chen bka' brgyad dkyil 'khor lha yi tshogs// bdun brgya nyer lnga bsang dang zhi bas mchod// rje btsun pad+ma badz+ra rtsal la sogs// bla ma dgongs 'dus dkyil 'khor phyi nang lha// bka' srung rta nag yab yum sras 'khor bcas// gter bdag klu btsan tshogs bcas bsang gis mchod// gu ru zhi drag rta phag dmar nag dang*// bla rdzogs thugs kyi dkyil 'khor cher bzhugs pa// zhi ba zhe gnyis khrag 'thung lnga bcu brgyad| |gsang sngags snga 'gyur bka' gter dkyil 'khor lha// ma lus lus pa med pa'i tshogs bcas la// bsang dang zhi ba'i dgyes mchod dam pa 'bul// kyai bsangs so// 'khor lo sdom pa dgyes pa rdo rje dang*// gsang ba 'dus pa dus kyi 'khor lo dang*// rdo rje gdan bzhi mā yā sangs rgyas thod// dmar nag 'jigs gsum gdong drug la sogs pa/ */ rnal 'byor pha ma gnyis med rgyud kyi lha// bla med nang gi rgyud sde'i lha tshogs bsangs// rdo rje rtse mo la sogs rnal 'byor rgyud// bya ba'i rgyud dang spyod pa'i rgyud sde sogs// gsang sngags phyi rgyud lha tshogs thams cad bsangs// rje btsun sgrol ma lha mo dbyangs can dang*// tsa rtsi ka sogs mdor na theg rim dgu// rgyud sde bzhis bsdus dkyil 'khor lha tshogs la// dgyes pa skong slad bsang gi mchod pa 'bul// mchog dang thun mong dngos grub stsal du gsol// gnyis pa mgon po yon tan gyi mgron rnams ni/ kyai bsangs so// gnas chen sum cu rtsa gnyis dang*/

yul chen nyer bzhi legs skyong ba'i// rdo rje rin chen pad+ma las// de bzhin rigs kyi dpa' bo dang*// sangs rgyas rdo rje rin po che// pad+ma las dang sna tshogs dang*// dam tshig rgyud 'dzin 'jig rten gyi// mkha' 'gro shugs 'gror bcas pa'i 'khor// ging dang laṅka pho nyar bcas// ma sring bye ba dung phyur tshogs// rang lus rtsa thig rlung gi lha// phyi nang gzhan gsum dbyer med pa'i// dpa' bo mkha' 'gror bcas kun la// bsang dang zhi ba'i mchod pa 'bul// dngos grub stsol la gdong grogs mdzod// kyai bsangs so/ dur khrod bsil ba tshal la sogs// gnas yul kun gyi zhing skyong gtso// rnam par gnon dang nā len+d+ra// de sogs gtsug lag khang kun srung*// sangs rgyas stong gi bstan bsrung phyir// 'khor lo sdom pa nyid sprul pa// mahā kā lā phyag bzhi pa/ thugs mgon bya rog gdong pa can// dbyings sbyor sgrol ba'i yum chen gsum// bya rog gdong bzhi seng gdong dang*// mkha' 'gro chen mo brgyad dang drug /nag po stong dang sha za 'bum// ma mo bye ba gnod sbyin khri// gang po mdzes ma sprul pa'i 'khor// bya dang gcan gzan tshogs bcas la| |bsang dang zhi ba'i mchod pa 'bul// gzhan yang myur mdzad phyag drug mgon// gur gyi mgon po zhal bzhi pa// beng chen ma ning trak+shad dang*// yab dang yum// dus mtshan pho mo sde brgyad bcas// 'khor dang bcas pa bsang gis mchod// srin po rak+ṣa dz+wa la dang*// klu mo rdo rje glog 'gyu'i sras// gza' chen khyab 'jug rā hu la// lus kyi dum /chos 'khor srung ba'i rtsi dmar ba// btsan 'khor 'bar ba'i tshogs bcas bsangs// rje rigs btsun mo'i gtsug lag khang*// srung mdzad rgyal po dung thod can// rnam thos dmar po'i ngo bo mchog /'khor bcas dgyes phyir bsang mchod 'bul// mgon po sngags srung srog sgrub dang*// shan pa dmar nag gza' rdor legs// rgyal po la sogs rang 'khor bcas// dam can sde bdun bsang gis mchod// dud sol ma dang lcags phur nag /re ma ti dang dpal 'bar ma// sring gcig lha mo la sogs pa// bstan srung dam can ma lus la// bsang dang zhi ba'i mchod pa 'bul// phrin las rnam bzhi 'grub par mdzod// kyai bsangs so// 'di nas byang phyogs ri bo'i rmang*// dpag tshad brgyad khri mar 'das na// rim pa bdun gyi sa 'og na// rgya mtsho gling gi bar shed na// lcags mkhar bcu bdun mnga' bdag po// shi ba rnams kyi gshin bu rje// gson po brkos la 'debs pa po// gson gshin gnyis kyi zam kha pa// dkar nag las kyi stangs gcod mkhan// las kyi gshin rje chos kyi rgyal// nag po rak+sha glog phreng can// bye ba gung rings sus mi zlog /yum ni gtum mo dug hrul ma// 'khor tshogs gshed chen rnam pa bzhi// khram bdag bcu gnyis chung mar bcas// gshin rje ma mo 'byung po dang*| |sha za yi dwags 'khor bcas la// bsang dang zhi ba'i mchod pa 'bul// dregs pa'i sde dpon sum cu dang*// sngags bdag dregs pa bco brgyad dang*// phyi nang gsang sbas bstan skyong dang*// drag sngags btags chags ma chags dang*// las byed bstan srung sde brgyad la// bsang dang zhi ba'i mchod pa 'bul// kyai/ yul gyi ming ni rgya gar yul// sku la rdzogs pa'i dur khrod na// zla gsang chos kyi bya ra ba// bang so dmar po'i gter srung bsangs// rnal 'byor bstan srung dgra bgegs sgrol// kyai bsangs so// 'phags pa rmugs 'dzin dkar ser dmar// nag po dang ni tshogs kyi bdag

bai ro tsa na la sogs pa'i// bod kyi lo chen thams cad la// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul bstod par bgyi// bdag la dbang bskur byin gyis rlobs/ kyai/ phyi nang gsang ba'i mchod pa dang*// sbyor sgrol tshogs kyi mchod pa dang*// sman raka gtor tshogs rgya mtsho yis// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed po che// yab yum sras sprul 'khor tshogs bcas// thugs dam bskang phyir bdag gis ni// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul bstod par bgyi// 'jam dpal rtsa ba'i lha chen drug /gyad gnon brgyad dang khro chen bcu// sprul pa gsum dang gshed chen bzhi// mon bdud brgyad dang 'chi bdag bcu gnyis dang*// gshin rje so gnyis sgo ba bzhi// gshin rje bdun brgya nyi shu la// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul bstod par bgyi// rig rgyal nā ga rak+sha dang*// ki kang dmar nag khro chu dang*// kha thun 'char ka bse par sogs// 'jam dpal lha rgyud thams cad la| |phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul bstod par bgyi// drang srong dri med bshes gnyen dang*// khro rgyal zhe sdang rdo rje che// sprul 'khor drang srong 'bum bcas la// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul bstod par bgyi// che mchog yang dag gshin rje dang*// rta mgrin phur pa ma mo'i tshogs// rig 'dzin slob dpon mchod bstod dang*// drag sngags bka' sdod dam can bcas// sgrub chen bka' brgyad lha tshogs la// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul bstod par bgyi// rje btsun pad+ma badz+ra sogs// bla ma dgongs 'dus lha tshogs la// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul bstod par bgyi| |gu ru zhi drag rta phag dang*// rtsa ba gsum dang tshe dpag med// bla rdzogs thugs gsum bka' gter gyi// rten dang brten pa'i dkyil 'khor ni// zhing rdul grangs dang mnyam rnams la// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul bstod par bgyi// dpal ldan dus kyi 'khor lo sogs// gnyis med rgyud sde'i lha tshogs la// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul bstod par bgyi// bcom ldan gsang ba 'dus pa dang*// dmar nag 'jigs gsum gdong drug sogs// pha rgyud rigs drug lha tshogs la// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul bstod par bgyi// khrag 'thung 'khor lo sdom pa dang*// dgyes mdzad gdan bzhi mā yā sogs// ma rgyud rigs bdun lha tshogs la// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul bstod par bgyi// de nyid bsdus pa la sogs pa// rnal 'byor rigs lnga'i lha tshogs la// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul bstod par bgyi// rnam snang mngon byang la sogs pa// spyod rgyud rigs gsum lha tshogs la// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul bstod par bgyi// dam tshig gsum bkod la sogs pa// bya rgyud rigs drug lha tshogs la// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul bstod par bgyi// nang pa thabs kyi rgyud gsum dang*// phyi rgyud thub pa'i rgyud rnams dang*// theg pa rim dgu rgyud sde bzhi// phyi nang gsang sngags rigs sngags dang*// gzungs sngags la sogs 'bras bu yi// theg pa'i dkyil 'khor lha tshogs ni// ma lus lus pa med rnams la// phyag 'tshal mchod 'bul bstod par bgyi// mchog thun dngos grub stsal du gsol// kyai/

gangs ri ti se tsā ri tra// de sogs yul chen nyer bzhi dang*// gnas mchog sum cu rtsa bdun dang*// dur khrod brgyad dang gling chen bzhi// rang lus rtsa thig rlung gsum gyi// phyi nang gzhan gsum la gnas shing*| |rgyu ba'i dpa' bo dpa' mo dang*// mkha' 'gro ging dang laṅka dang*// ma sring gnyen po thams cad la// mchod pa sna tshogs gtor ma dang*/ sman raka tshogs kyi yo byad kyis// bskang ngo gsol lo brngan par bgyi// bar chad sol la gdong grogs mdzod// phrin las thams cad 'grub par gyis// hūm̐ */ sman raka gtor ma tan gaṇa dang*// rta lug g.yag khyi gos zhwa nag /dar gdugs rgyal mtshan 'dod yon lnga// bya rog rgyal mtshan gri snying dang*// 'bod rbad bsad zlog mnan sreg dang*// zor rdzas ting 'dzin gsang sngags kyis// dpal ldan mgon po phyag bzhi pa/ yum chen tshogs dang bya rog gdong*// seng ge'i gdong can mkha' 'gro brgyad// nag po stong dang sha za 'bum/ ma mo bye ba gnod sbyin khri// yang sprul pho nya phyogs skyong dang*// ro langs gnod spyin bdud pho mo// bya gcan tshogs bcas dgyes par brngan// gzhan yang phyag drug gur dang zhal// beng 'dzin ma ning stag zhon dang*// trak+shad rta mang gri gug dang*// ber nag seng zhon srog bdud dang*// lha chen dpal 'bar legs ldan che// rnam mang thos sras la sogs pa'i// dpal ldan mgon po 'khor bcas brngan// phyi mchod nang mchod sman lnga dang*// sman raka gtor ma tshogs su bcas// g.yab dar sngon po dkor mdzod nor// 'bri sngon shel sgong lug dkar dang*/ rta 'brong mkha' lding rgya bong dang*| |khrung khrung rgyal mtshan gser g.yu 'bru// le brgan dar dang sba lcag dang*// 'dzab bstod dngul dkar me long dang*// bzang drug sman sna dar zab tshogs// rol mo brjid ldan gtor mar bcas// 'dod yon longs spyod sna tshogs kyis// bstan srung chos kyi sgrol ma che// las dang ye shes dbang dam tshig

/thugs sprul gsum dang khro mo dmar// srog shan 'bum dang srog spu gri// sha za dmar nag stong snying bsgul// a phyi chen mo 'khor bcas brngan// dgyes pa'i mchod pa dpag med kyis// lha sman tshe ring 'khor bcas brngan// sman raka gtor ma sha khrag gi// bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho dpag med pas// ma mo gza' dang rdo rje legs// ha ra mi zan 'khor bcas brngan// rta lug g.yag khyi nag po dang*// sha gsur khu khrag lha rkang dang*// dbang lnga glo snying nang khrol gyis// sbags pa'i gtor chen sman raka dang*// dom nag snying dang sngags ting 'dzin// sha khrag chang dang mthun rdzas tshogs// ra yi rnam lnga sha chen khrag /zhag dang bshos bu dmar dang dkar// sha chang bza' btung mtha' yas pas// zhing skyong kun dga' gzhon nu dang*// si na rā ma las mkhan bcas| |sde brgyad 'khor bcas dgyes par brngan// mchog chen las byung mchod pa la// sha khrag nya rus btsos dang rjen// ra mchin dmar rjen dkar mngar gsum// klu sman la sman rtsi sman dang*// stag dom ba glang nya yi snying*// sha khrag snying sna klad rus rkang*// khu ba zhag dang sman raka dang*// gtor ma spyan gzigs sna tshogs kyis// gza' bdud chen po rā hu la| |yab yum sras dang gza' chen brgyad// sring bzhi gza' skar sde brgyad brngan// rta dkar de ni phrum dmar dang*// bya dkar de ni ze dmar dang*// khyi dkar de ni sna dmar dang*// sprel dkar de ni ngo dmar dang*// gser g.yu shel sgong spyan gzigs dang*// dkor cha sna tshogs dpag med kyis// zhal gsum stod kyi mi bo che// dkar dmar nag dang sku lngar bcas| |yum sras blon 'bangs ru 'dren tshogs// dkor bdag chen po 'khor bcas brngan// bse yi ya lad mdung zhags dmar// ral gri mda' rten sgro ldan tshogs// sna tshogs 'dod yon dpag med kyis// srog bdag gnod sbyin rtsi dmar che// rol pa skya bdun btsan gyi 'khor/

bye ba sa yar bcas pa brngan// phyi nang gsang mchod sman raka dang*// gtor ma ra dkar snying gis brgyan// rin chen sna tshogs dar zab tshogs// sman 'bru sba smyug 'dod yon gyis// bstan srung tshangs pa 'khor bcas brngan// gtor mchod 'dod yon sna tshogs kyis// dam can mgar nag 'khor bcas brngan// gzhan yang phyi nang gsang mchod dang*// sman raka gtor ma 'dod yon lnga// mthun rdzas nam mkha'i khams bkang bas// bstan pa bsrung bar zhal bzhes pa// 'jig rten 'das dang ma 'das pa'i// chos skyong bstan srung dam can tshogs// 'khor bcas brngan cing thugs dam bskang*// thugs dang 'gal ba bshags bgyid na// nongs pa tshangs shing bzod mdzad nas// phrin las rnam bzhi myur du sgrubs// kyai/ bam chen las byung dbang lnga dang*// sman raka gtor ma spyan gzigs tshogs/ dgra bo'i sha khrag rkang klad rus// khu zhag chu ser rgyud pa dang*// mgo dang yan lag glo snying sogs// nang khrol bcas pa'i 'dod yon gyis// las kyi gshin rje srog dbugs bdag /'chi bdag nyi zla'i 'od zer can// yab yum gshed bzhi khram bdag bcas// ma gshin sha za yi dwags 'khor// dregs pa'i tshogs bcas tshim par brngan// kyai/ sman raka gtor mchod 'dod yon gyis// zla gsang chos kyi bya ra ba/ /bang so dmar po'i gter srung brngan/ /tshim par mdzod la phrin las sgrubs// kyai/ lha klu mi yi rin chen tshogs| |rin thang med pa sna tshogs dang*// dar zab rkang bzhi 'bru dang sman// spos dang bza' bca' btung ba dang*// spyan gzigs dkor nor mtha' yas pas// rmugs 'dzin dkar ser dmar dang nag /nor rgyun ma dang tshogs bdag dang*// ku be ra dang tri sha dang*// gnod sbyin pho brgyad mo brgyad dang*// gnod sbyin nor lha pho mo'i tshogs// rab tu dgyes tshim brngan par bgyi// dpal 'byor nor gyi dngos grub stsol// phyogs skyong lha klu gza' skar dang*// 'jigs byed rgyal chen bcas pa'i tshogs// gtsang ris dpal mgon bdun cu lnga// yid dang mthun pa'i gtor mas brngan// slob dpon rgyud dang chos srung dang*// gsang sngags phyi nang srung ma dang*// dben gnas pha mes rigs srung ma// khyad par bka' brgyud 'di nyid kyi// snying po'i bstan srung 'khor bcas rnams// rang rang rigs mthun gtor mas brngan// bar gcod sel zhing mgon mdzad lha// gdong grogs srung skyob byed pa dang*// bka' srung dam can rgya mtsho'i tshogs// mthun pa'i mchod gtor rdzas kyis brngan// bdag gi 'gal rkyen bar gcod sol// mthun rkyen ma lus 'grub pa dang*// srung skyob zlog bsad phrin las sgrubs// kyai/

spyan gzigs longs spyod dpag med kyis// sngags 'chang bdag la 'go ba'i lha// dgra lha pho lha yul lha dang*// srog lha zhang lha ma lha dang*| |rigs 'dzin srung ma bang lha dang*// lhan cig skyes pa'i lha la sogs// 'go ba'i lha tshogs thams cad brngan// bdag la lus dang grib ma ltar// 'grogs nas rtag tu srung skyob mdzod// go cha sra dang mtshon rno tshogs// ma tshang med pa 'dod dgu yis// dgra lha spun dgu 'khor bcas brngan// dgra dpung chom la rang srid skyongs// gzhan yang mchod gtor 'dod yon tshogs// nam mkha' khengs pa'i rdzas mchog gis// pha mtshun yab lha spun drug dang*// bar lha khyim lha mkhar gyi lha// nang lha sgo lha thab lha dang*// zhing lha rta lha lam gyi lha| |phyugs lha mdzo lha 'bri lha dang*// lug lha ra lha nor lha dang*// tshong lha gter bdag gter srung sogs// las dang skal pa nus mthu dang*// ldan zhing gdong grogs bzang byed pa'i| |lha srung gnyen po thams cad brngan// 'gal rkyen sol la mthun rkyen sgrubs// kyai/ bod khams skyong ba brtan ma'i tshogs// dkar mo lha yi bu mo bzhi// dmar mo gnod sbyin srin mo bzhi// nag mo bdud kyi lcam mo bzhi// skyong ma yang mar bcas pa rnams// bshos bu snying dang gtor mas brngan// slob dpon pad+ma'i bka' bzhin du// bod khams skyong la mtha' dmag zlog /chos rje'i dge bsnyen chen po bzhi// bar lha lha dang sog ra btsan/ chu 'phan klu dang gter sgrom sman// tsog sna'i rnam rgyal dkar po sogs// yid dang mthun pa'i gtor mas brngan// rgyal ba klu zhabs nyid sprul pa// rat+na shrī'i bka' bzhin du// snying po'i bstan pa rgyas par mdzod// srid pa chags pa'i lha dgu dang*// rje yi mgur lha bcu gsum dang*| |mtha' yi dge bsnyen nyer gcig dang*// dge bsnyen sum brgya drug cur bcas// bod khams chags pa'i zo dor tshogs// rang rang rigs mthun gtor mas brngan// na bza' rin chen sna tshogs kyis// lha yi dbang po brgya byin brngan// tshangs pa gser gyi phye mas brngan// lha rnams 'dod yon lnga yis brngan// lha min me tog phreng bas brngan// klu rnams dkar mngar gtor mas brngan/

/gnyan rnams dar dang stag gis brngan/ /sa bdag gser dang dngul gyis brngan// lha mo brtan ma bum pas brngan// dri za dri dang gsur gyis brngan// srin po sha dang khrag gis brngan// lto 'phye grul bum mi'am ci// mchod pa sna tshogs gtor mas brngan// rgyal po sba dang smyug gis brngan// dge bsnyen sha dang chang gis brngan// yid kyi gzugs can thams cad la// yid dang mthun pa'i gtor mas brngan// gong gi btsan rnams gong khar brngan// dmu bdud so so'i gnas su bcos| |dam sri dam 'dre dam la btags// rgya mtshor gnas pa'i klu chen brgyad// klu rten rgyan dang bcas pas brngan// bar snang gnas pa'i gza' chen brgyad/ gza' ra rog po'i snying gis brngan// rgyu skar nyi shu rtsa brgyad dang*// blon po sum cu rtsa bdun rnams// rin chen gser skyems dag gis brngan// gza' tshes skar sbyor byed pa dang*// lo zla zhag dus spar sme yi// sa bdag rgyal blon chung ma 'khor// 'dod yon sna tshogs gtor mas brngan// 'phrog ma ma bu lnga brgya ni// sor mo lngas bcangs gtor mas brngan// rigs kyi srung ma thams cad la// rigs dang mthun pa'i gtor mas brngan// sgo bzhi'i srung ma dong rtses brngan// rgya gar shar lho nub byang dbus// rgya nag phyogs mtshams mtha' dbus bcas// li dang bal po shaṃ bha la// o rgyan stag gzig ge sar yul// wa zha zhang zhung grum pa dang*// bha ta hor dang kla klo'i yul// za hor thod dkar ma ru rtse// kha che bhe ta pad+ma can// pur rgyal bod dang mnga' ris ljongs// dbus gtsang ru bzhi mdo khams drug /dbu ru stod smad nyin sribs kyi// gzhi bdag che gnyan chung ba kun// rang rang yid mthun gtor mas brngan// khyad par sngags 'chang bdag cag gi// sa phyogs yul phyogs gnas 'di yi// phu mda' bar dang nyin sribs kyi// gnam sa bar gsum ri dang brag /g.ya' gangs spang dang nags dang thang*| |mtsho dang 'bab chu rdzing chu mig

/sa rdo shing lam 'phrang lha khang*// rgyal khab grong dgon tshong dus lhas// 'brog bod kun la gnas pa yi// gnyug mar 'tsho ba'i gzhi bdag tshogs| |lha klu btsan bdud sa bdag sman// rgyal bsen yul lha yul 'dre sogs// gzhi bdag gnas bdag dkor bdag kun// yid dang mthun pa'i gtor ma dang*// 'dod yon longs spyod rdzas kyis brngan// lha srung gnyan po khyed rnams kun// de ring bzang byed bzang la byon// rin chen 'bras kyi g.yag lug ra// bdud rtsi gser skyems bshos bu 'bul// bdag gi bsam don kun 'grub mdzod// kyai/ stong gsum phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi// lha dang lha min mi rnams dang*// dmyal ba yi dwags dud 'gror bcas| |rang rang yid dang mthun pa yi// bza' btung rgyan gos gtor mas brngan// so so'i sdug bsngal rab zhi nas// rnam dag rdzogs byang thob par shog /kyai/ rig 'dzin sngags 'chang bdag cag gi// thog med tshe rabs nas bzung ste// da lta'i lus 'di yan chad du// khams gsum 'gro drug sems can la// bsad bcad srog dang bsdigs brdungs nad// brkus phrogs zas nor lan chags kun// mchod pa sna tshogs gtor ma dang*// srog bcad stong du tshe thar dang*// bsdigs brngungs lan du rtsi sman gsos// brkus phrogs 'jal du mkho dgu'i nor// sha 'khon skyin du phud dang skyems// bu lon dod du 'dod yon bcas// gang 'dod so sor de ring brngan// bdag gi lhag bsam rnam dag pas// legs par 'bul gyi dga' bas bzhes// tshims shing rang bas mgu bar gyis// bsad bcad stong 'dril bcal zin to// bsdigs brdungs gsos sman byas zin to// brkus phrogs 'jal gyis bskangs zin to| |sha 'khon phud kyis sbyangs zin to// bu lon dod kyis tshang zin to// sngags 'chang bdag cag 'khor bcas kyi// lan chags byang zhing bu lon 'khor// sha 'khon dag cing tshogs rdzogs nas// thams cad byams brtse'i sems bskyed de// bla med byang chub myur 'thob shog

/bdag cag dpon slob 'khor bcas la// gnod pa'i bgegs rigs gnod byed dang*// nad bdag rims bdag yams bdag rnams// yid dang mthun pa'i gtor mas brngan// gnod pa'i bsam pa zhi ba dang*// nad rims chod la phan pa sgrubs// sngags 'chang rnal 'byor bdag cag la// ban sngags bon dgra sdang byed kyis// rbad pa'i srung ma 'jig rten las// 'das dang ma 'das 'khor bcas rnams// mchod pa sna tshogs gtor mas brngan// gnod sems spong la zhi bar byos// yang na byad ma'i steng du zlog /byad ma rang gshed rang la phob// dam la ma 'da' sa ma ya// de nas dpal gsol ba ni/ lha rten la phye mar gyi khu ye byugs shing*/ kyai| dgung sngon mthon po'i dpal bab pas// mtho la yangs pa'i dpal gsol lo// dro 'jam nyi ma'i dpal bab pas// kun la khyab pa'i dpal gsol lo// dkar gsal zla ba'i dpal bab pas// mtha' dbus med pa'i dpal gsol lo// gza' dang rgyu skar dpal bab pas// bkra shis phun tshogs dpal gsol lo// rtsa brgyud bla ma'i dpal bab pas// byin rlabs smin grol dpal gsol lo// yi dam zhi khro'i dpal bab pas// dngos grub thob pa'i dpal gsol lo// ma sring mkha' 'gro'i dpal bab pas// bar gcod kun zhi'i dpal gsol lo// chos skyong srung ma'i dpal bab pas// phrin las lhun grub dpal gsol lo// snang srid dregs pa'i dpal bab pas// dgra bgegs kun 'joms dpal gsol lo// nor bdag nor lha'i dpal bab pas// nor rdzas 'dzad med dpal gsol lo// rgyal chen rigs bzhi'i dpal bab pas// gzhan gyis mi thub dpal gsol lo| |'bar ba spun bdun dpal bab pas// ngar dang ldan pa'i dpal gsol lo// 'go ba'i lha lnga'i dpal bab pas// mi 'bral 'grogs pa'i dpal gsol lo// zhang zhung bon gyi dpal bab pas// bu nor 'dzom pa'i dpal gsol lo// bsod nams bsags pa'i dpal bab pas// 'byor dgu rgyas pa'i dpal gsol lo// cang shes rta yi dpal bab pas//

rgyun du zhon pa'i dpal gsol lo// dam pa chos kyi dpal bab pas// don gnyis 'grub pa'i dpal gsol lo// phun sum tshogs pa'i dpal bab pas// gzhan smon bdag skyid dpal gsol lo// gnod sbyin tshogs kyi dpal bab pas// dbul 'phong sel ba'i dpal gsol lo// dbang phyug chen po'i dpal bab pas// khams gsum dbang sdud dpal gsol lo// tshe dpag med pa'i dpal bab pas// 'chi med tshe yi dpal gsol lo// yul lha gzhi bdag dpal bab pas// gdong grogs byed pa'i dpal gsol lo// zhes brjod/ rjes la lam lha mchod pa ni/ kyai/ nam mkha' dkar po'i yang steng na// g.yu 'brug sngon mo'i lam lha mchod// rma bya sngon mo'i lam lha mchod// rgya stag khra bo'i lam lha mchod// thang dkar rgod po'i lam lha mchod| |glang po kha dkar lam lha mchod// re 'jam sngon mo'i lam lha mchod// dug sbrul dkar po'i lam lha mchod// lam g.yag zil po'i lam lha mchod// yid dang mthun pa'i gzugs brnyan gyis// skyes bu dpa' ba'i lam lha mchod// 'og rta mgyogs pa'i lam lha mchod// go cha btsan po'i lam lha mchod// rno ba mtshon gyi lam lha mchod// sra ba ber gyi lam lha mchod// bdas na zin pa'i lam lha mchod// bros na thar pa'i lam lha mchod// shags kyis thub pa'i lam lha mchod// 'gro na mgyogs pa'i lam lha mchod| |ci bsam 'grub pa'i lam lha mchod// byes la 'gro ba'i lam lha mchod// kha zas dang sprod pa'i lam lha mchod// sa dang lam gyi dgra lha mchod// de rnams mchod pa'i yon tan gyis// da res mgron po'i kha 'dzin mdzod// la ni bcu gsum la nye bzang*// sngon mo khrus byed dag dul lo// spun dgu btsan po'i gos gyon zhig /g.yu 'brug gser mdog gos gyon zhig /rno byed dgra lha gos gyon zhig /dpa' byed dgra lha gos gyon zhig /btsan byed dgra lha gos gyon zhig /thob byed dgra lha gos gyon zhig
